title: Eventstream retrospective recompute operator with watermark-corrected backfills
creator: Aisha Kaur
description: Build a resilient 'retrospective recompute operator' to perform correctness-first backfills and reprocessing of console usage analytics. The operator will: 1) produce watermark-corrected replay windows to ensure time-aligned aggregates; 2) enforce idempotent writes (event-id + schema-version) to prevent double counting; 3) support per-tenant throttled backfills with dynamic cost estimation; 4) provide dry-run validation that compares recomputed aggregates to golden snapshots. This ticket covers design, coordinator service implementation, worker pool, checkpointing model, dry-run validation harness, and dashboards for rollout monitoring. The operator must be compatible with both Kafka-based event archives and S3 time-partitioned event exports used by larger customers.
